receipts.note_on_prior_audit: context/BENCHMARK_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md recorded COMPASS as NOT FOUND; that search used the bare name (heavily overloaded). With FINAL_PLAN's arXiv id 2601.01836 the artifact resolves immediately. The audit line is OVERTURNED.
receipts.caveat: Existence check only — no measurements run on COMPASS in E-B3. Its labels live in model RESPONSES (refusal-behavior eval), so it is structurally closer to IFEval than to the text-classification benchmarks gauntleted here.
